# arin_aspas (Data Source)

List hosted RPKI ASPAs for an organization, including customer and provider ASNs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_aspas" "example" {
  org_handle = "FT-684"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_handle` (String) ARIN organization handle.

### Read-Only

- `aspas` (Attributes List) Records returned by ARIN, ordered deterministically. An empty collection is an empty list; authorization and missing-object errors remain errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aspas))

<a id="nestedatt--aspas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aspas`

Read-Only:

- `customer_asn` (Number) customer asn returned by ARIN.
- `provider_asns` (List of Number) provider asns returned by ARIN.
